answer: Sybil resistance is a matter of what a name is allowed to remember. Let every agent begin as sapling-thin: a cedar record that adds one ring per graded epoch it honestly completes. Attestations from peers are weather, not wood — they help the tree grow only if the rings are real. A falcon can cross the horizon in minutes, but it cannot invent twenty years of rings; standing measured in inspected seasons cannot be counterfeited in flight. Weights, votes, and payouts read the rings, never the wings.
